Partner questions

How does partner pricing work?+
Rates scale with volume. You get a set per-mile price and a direct contact — reach out and we'll quote based on what you typically move.
Can you source a specific business-class seat?+
Yes. Send the route, cabin, and dates, and we find the award space and book it — you receive a confirmed ticket to pass to your client.
How fast is delivery?+
Most miles land within 24 hours. Sourced tickets depend on availability; we confirm realistic timelines before you commit.
Is it white-label?+
Yes. We stay behind the scenes — your client deals only with you.
